data.title: The Right Tool for the Job
data.description: A skid steer can swap its bucket for other tools. Pick the attachment each job needs.

challenges.instruction: Lift the pallet of bricks off the ground. Pick the attachment for the job, then press Do the job.
Scoop up the pile of dirt and carry it away. Pick the attachment for the job, then press Do the job.
Clean the dust and leaves off the concrete path. Pick the attachment for the job, then press Do the job.
Pick up the pile of long branches. Pick the attachment for the job, then press Do the job.
Dig a deep hole where the orange stake is, so the little tree can be planted. Pick the attachment for the job, then press Do the job.
